name: Snowline Gold Corp.
summary: Snowline Gold Corp. is a Vancouver-based Canadian company focused on discovering and developing gold resources, with exploration that also covers molybdenum, copper, vanadium, nickel, zinc and silver. Its key asset is the Rogue gold project in the Selwyn Basin of Yukon. Established in 2017, it was previously named Skyledger Tech Corp. until 2021.
